Job description

NetM Corporate Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is hiring skilled and aspiring IT and Non-IT professionals for multiple opportunities across India. We are looking for candidates with experience or knowledge in software development, application development, IT consulting, technical support, software testing, cloud computing, data analytics, automation, and business operations.

Candidates with 05 years of experience from different technical and non-technical educational backgrounds are welcome to apply. Suitable roles and designations will be offered based on candidates' qualifications, experience, technical expertise, and interview performance.


Roles & Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications based on business requirements.
  • Work on application development using Java, Python, C, C++, .NET, and other programming technologies.
  • Develop and execute SQL queries and support database management activities.
  • Assist in software testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and quality assurance.
  • Provide application support and resolve technical issues.
  • Work with Oracle, SAP, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications.
  • Support cloud computing, automation, and technology implementation activities.
  • Perform data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence activities.
  • Understand business requirements and assist in providing appropriate technical solutions.
  • Support IT consulting, project coordination, and business operations.
  • Collaborate with technical and non-technical teams to deliver project objectives.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and project updates.
  • Identify process improvements and contribute to operational efficiency.

Preferred Candidate Profile:


  • Candidates with 0 to 5 years of experience in IT or Non-IT domains.
  • Freshers and experienced professionals with relevant technical or functional knowledge can apply.
  • Educational qualifications in B.Tech, B.E., MCA, M.Tech, MBA, BCA, BBA, B.Sc, B.Com, BA, Diploma, or any equivalent degree.
  • Basic to good knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, C, C++, and .NET.
  • Knowledge of SQL, databases, Oracle, SAP, Cloud Computing, Software Testing, or Application Support is preferred.
  • Candidates with exposure to Data Analytics, Automation, IT Consulting, or Business Operations will be an added advantage.
  • Good communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to different project requirements.
  • Candidates willing to work in Hybrid / Remote work environments.

About company

About NetM Corporate Solutions Pvt. Ltd.


NetM Corporate Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a Bengaluru-based Information Technology and Consulting company specializing in IT Staffing, Recruitment, Consulting Services, Product Development, and Digital Transformation Solutions.

Established in 2022, NetM Corp partners with organizations across industries to deliver skilled technology professionals and innovative business solutions.


With expertise spanning Cloud Technologies, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, ERP, Microsoft Technologies, and Software Development, NetM Corp is committed to helping clients build high-performing teams and accelerate their digital transformation initiatives.


Driven by a customer-centric approach, quality delivery, and industry expertise, NetM Corp provides end-to-end workforce solutions, technology consulting, and product development services while fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented work environment for its employees.
